styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Hakka villages, museums and the old Luohu streets.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Cantonese dim sum, street snacks and late-night seafood.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: City parks, coastal trails and hilltop views.

stays.why: Central and well connected by metro; good base for parks, malls and day trips across the city.
Old downtown next to the Hong Kong border crossing; busy shopping streets and easy metro links.
Tech district with theme parks and coastal walks; handy for Shenzhen Bay and the western sights.
Waterfront area with the ferry terminal to Hong Kong, Macau and Zhuhai; relaxed expat feel.

food: Start with Cantonese dim sum for breakfast or lunch; order a few baskets to share and expect queues at popular spots.
Try street snacks in older districts: rice rolls, fish balls and grilled skewers; prices are low, often under ¥30 a portion.
Seafood is a local favourite; pick your fish and agree the price per weight before cooking.
Night markets and food streets are busiest after 8pm; go hungry and carry small cash as a backup.
Book popular restaurants ahead on weekends; many city malls have good mid-range chains with English menus.
more_time: Add a day trip to a nearby Hakka village or old town for a slower look at local history.
Spend an afternoon on a coastal walk or hill trail if the weather is dry and cool.
Cross to Hong Kong by metro or ferry for a day if your visa allows; check entry rules before you go.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the main parks, a museum and plenty of eating; add a night for a coastal walk or a Hong Kong day trip.

month_notes: Cool and dry: highs near 20°C, lows near 12°C. Pack a jacket for evenings.
Similar to January: mild days, cool nights, about 7 rain days.
Warming up to 24°C; more showers, so carry a light rain jacket.
Warm and wetter: 27°C highs and around 14 rain days.
Hot and rainy: 29°C highs, 21 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
Peak rainy season: 30°C highs, 25 rain days, humid and sticky.
Hot and very wet: 31°C highs, 24 rain days. Expect afternoon downpours.
Similar to July: hot, humid, 25 rain days.
Still hot and wet: 30°C highs, 21 rain days. Typhoon season; check forecasts.
Rain eases: 28°C highs, 9 rain days. Comfortable again.
Pleasant: 25°C highs, 18°C lows, about 7 rain days.
Cool and dry: 21°C highs, 13°C lows, only 4 rain days. Great for walking.

climate_guide.summary: Subtropical and humid: mild dry winters, hot wet summers, and a long rainy season from spring to autumn.

items.title: Best time: November to March
items.text: Mild, mostly dry days around 20–25°C. Ideal for parks, walking and sightseeing.

items.title: Hot, humid summer
items.text: June to September brings 30–31°C highs and heavy humidity. Move slowly and use air-conditioned breaks.

items.title: Long rainy season
items.text: May to September has 21–25 rain days a month. Carry an umbrella and keep plans flexible.

items.title: Typhoon season
items.text: Storms are possible roughly summer to early autumn. Check forecasts and transport alerts before travel.

items.title: Pack for rain and sun
items.text: Light layers, a compact umbrella, quick-dry shoes and sunscreen. A light jacket helps in winter.

items.title: Indoor backups
items.text: Malls, museums and food halls are good rainy-day options; save outdoor trails for dry days.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; use Didi or taxis for late nights and airport runs.

modes.text: Fast, cheap and covers most sights; fares from about ¥2.
Buses fill the gaps; use a transit card or phone app to pay.
Taxis and ride apps like Didi work well; airport to Futian about ¥100.
Driving yourself is not advised for short visits; traffic is heavy.
Walking is fine in central districts; shared bikes are everywhere.
Ferries link Shekou and Fuyong to Hong Kong, Macau and Zhuhai.
